name: @stella-org/lazuli
description: An official package manager for the Stella programming language.
author: Katsujukou Kineya

scripts.bundle: rm -rf output output-es && spago build -p cli --pure && purs-backend-es bundle-module -p node -y -m Lazuli.CLI.JS -t ./dist/lib/bundle.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run copy && npm run bundle
scripts.version: echo 'export const version = "v'$npm_package_version'";' > ./cli/src/Lazuli/CLI/Version.js && git add package.json ./cli/src/Lazuli/CLI/Version.js
